services.name: Boat Charters
services.desc: Celebrate life’s biggest moments with a private boat rental in Chicago designed for unforgettable experiences. Our fleet of sailboats, yachts, and big boats is ideal for celebrations and private events of all kinds, offering flexibility, comfort, and a professionally captained experience your guests will love. From intimate gatherings to lively group celebrations, hosting your event on the water delivers stunning views, fresh air, and a one-of-a-kind setting you simply can’t replicate on land. With customizable itineraries and experienced captains included, we make it easy to plan an event that feels effortless and elevated. Weddings, Proposals & Wedding Parties Hosting a proposal,

blurb: Offers captained charters for sailboats, yachts, and big boats for groups from 1 to 36 people. Activities include daytime sailing, sunset cruises, swimming and sunbathing sails, and Navy Pier fireworks viewing. Booking is done online with direct payment and captain booking instructions provided after.

quotes.text: We had an excellent charter experience with Captain Bill on a speedboat. Booking the boat was quite easy through the website, then you can contact the captain yourself to see who is available (company gives names/contact info). I would definitely rent from CSC again. Prices were also pretty average compared to other companies! Definitely recommend. “ Gabrielle W.

Captain Rob and Jill were great. Everything ran like clockwork and they were accommodating on the boat. Great conversationalists as well. I appreciated the simplicity of booking and acquiring their services. It felt a little too easy to be true but it was. They just have an efficient and fun operation. Thanks captain Rob and Jill!” MM

After doing a ton of research, I came upon Chicago Sailboat Charters. I found them through their amazing reviews and recommendations. They were quick to respond and answered all of my questions. I ending up booking a Cruiser Class Power Boat for a bachelorette party of 11 girls.” Lindsey S.
